reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduleAmount, the same helper forecast and the schedules app already use for the expected amount.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-written; the field is a single delegating line.

placement.why: Computed in scheduleModel.toExternal, where the API shapes schedules, and declared optional so the create/update input type is unaffected.

scope.why: Three added lines in the API model only.

maintainability.why: Minimal and obviously correct by construction; only a nit on import ordering.
